Manage Saved Queries in Compass
Copy page

MongoDB Compass Readonly Edition will be deprecated in a future release. To replicate the read-only behavior in a standard Compass edition, assign users 
read
 access at the database level and enable the readOnly option in Compass.

After you connect to your cluster, you can load saved queries from the My Queries view. This page explains how to add and view favorite queries.

Save a Favorite Query

You can favorite a query so that you can find it later. If you load a favorite query, you can change it without changing the original saved copy.

To add a query to your favorites:

1
Open query history

Click the History button on the query bar in the Documents pane.

click to enlarge
2
Select favorites

Hover over your query and click the Star button.

click to enlarge
3
Name your query

Enter a name for your query.

..step:: Click Save.

View Saved Queries

After you connect to your cluster, you can view your saved queries and aggregation pipelines on the My Queries tab.

NOTE

To learn how to save and view aggregation pipelines, see:

Save a Pipeline

Open a Saved Pipeline

Use the My Queries Tab

When you click a saved or favorite query tile, Compass opens the Documents tab with the filter loaded.

In the My Queries tab, you can also click a saved aggregation pipeline tile to open the Aggregations tab with the pipeline loaded.

Use the Favorites Tab

You can also view favorite queries from the Favorites tab from in the Documents view. To open the Favorites tab:

1
Open query history

Click the History button at the top of the Documents tab.

click to enlarge
2
Click the Favorites button in the past queries pane.

Select your favorited operation.

If your favorited operation is a query, only a Filter statement displays in the Favorites list view along with copy  and delete  icons.

NOTE

Clicking a favorited query in the Favorites list view populates your Query Bar with that query.

If your favorited operation is a bulk update statement, a Filter and Update statement display in the Favorites list view along with copy , delete , and  open in modal icons.

NOTE

Clicking the  icon opens the bulk update statement and the filter criteria in the Update Documents modal. For details on bulk update statements in Compass, see Modify Multiple Documents.

View Query History

For details on how to view query history see viewing recent query history.
